Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.
Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry.

You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape.

You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took
You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one
You use AI as more than a better search engine. You’ve built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it
You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it’s what lets you find the pain before a customer names it
You’re consultative by instinct. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo-ready buyers aren’t the motion here
You work in German and English at a professional level. Discovery, demos, and negotiation happen in German; the company runs in English

Months 1-6: Master the product, close your first 5-10 deals, build your DACH network
Months 6-18: Take on larger deals, navigate complex stakeholder environments, mentor BDRs
18+ months: Transition to Enterprise AE (€100k+ deals), own strategic accounts, mentor junior AEs
Your performance objectives
📣 Generate pipeline
Build your network. Connect with 50+ relevant decision-makers at electronics manufacturers per quarter through industry events, LinkedIn, and targeted outreach. Establish Luminovo's presence at 2-3 key industry fairs annually.
Generate qualified pipeline. Create €240k-€400k in qualified pipeline ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) through outbound prospecting, events, and inbound lead qualification using SPICED discovery.
Qualify with precision. Run customer-centric discovery to uncover Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical event, and Decision criteria. Quantify potential value before investing in lengthy sales cycles.
💪 Close opportunities
Inspire with demos. Deliver product demonstrations tailored to each customer's pain points. Clearly articulate our competitive positioning.
Prove measurable value. Collaborate with domain experts to run workshops that demonstrate ROI through concrete impact calculations (time savings, cost reductions, efficiency gains).
Close strategically. Guide prospects through complex buyer journeys, map stakeholders, and turn negotiations into win-win outcomes. Close €60k-€100k in new ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) with smooth handovers to Customer Success.
💡 Build expertise
Become an industry insider. Develop deep knowledge of electronics supply chains and feed customer insights back to product teams.
Master consultative selling. Make SPICED your guiding principle and build expertise in technical SaaS sales with longer cycles and multi-stakeholder decisions.
📈 Lead by example
Own your metrics. Monitor pipeline health, conversion rates, and deal velocity. Use data to consistently hit quarterly targets.
Enable your peers. Mentor junior AEs through shadowing and deal reviews. Contribute to our sales playbook.
Embrace feedback. Reflect on every major customer interaction and proactively seek coaching to maximize impact.

You'll primarily cover the German-speaking market (DACH), with some English-speaking territories. Fluency in 🇩🇪 German and 🇬🇧 English is essential.

Munich headquarters or Berlin satellite office (both in hybrid setup with home-office flexibility). Our sales team meets in the office three days per week. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events (expenses covered).

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.
For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.
AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.
At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience.

But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.
We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.
Check out our principles to see how we work.

You will be pivotal to telli’s growth. Your mission is to drive revenue by building trusted relationships with enterprise customers and closing complex, high-value deals (€100k+ land deal size). As one of the first Sr. Enterprise AEs at telli, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we win, navigate, and scale our enterprise sales motion.

Own complex enterprise deals end-to-end: Lead €100k+ deals from first discovery through signature, including demos, business cases, security reviews, procurement, legal, contract negotiations, and executive alignment. You uncover where telli creates measurable value and build the case to make it a priority.
Build and own your pipeline: Our SDR team supports you, but you can generate own Enterprise pipeline. You identify the right accounts, develop account strategies, write outbound, make the calls, and create opportunities where none existed before.
Navigate complex buying committees: Build relationships across Sales, Operations, CX, IT, Security, Legal, Procurement, Finance, and the C-Suite at large organizations. You identify champions, understand internal politics, and create consensus across multiple stakeholders.
Run strategic, multi-threaded sales processes: You don't rely on a single champion. You map the organization, understand who influences the decision, and build relationships at multiple levels long before procurement enters the process.
Own a quota and close €100k+ deals: Drive meaningful new ARR and take full accountability for your forecast, pipeline coverage, and revenue target.
Build compelling business cases: Translate telli's product into measurable commercial impact for the customer and make the ROI clear enough to win internal budget and executive sponsorship.
Bring the customer into the company: Feed structured insights back into product, marketing, and strategy. You sit closest to some of our most important prospects and customers, and your signal helps shape what we build next.

s.h: what makes you a great fit
s.t:
You have 3+ years of experience closing enterprise deals: You have proven experience owning complex €100k+ sales cycles and selling to senior and C-Suite economic buyers.
You know how to navigate complexity: You've worked through long sales cycles involving multiple departments, procurement, security, legal, and competing internal priorities, without losing control of the deal.
You're an elite relationship builder: You know the difference between a contact, a champion, and an economic buyer. You build trust quickly and have won deals because of the relationships you created across an organization.
You're a hunter: You know how to manufacture pipeline without relying on a warm inbound stream. You're comfortable breaking into large accounts and creating urgency from scratch.
You have executive presence: You can hold your own with C-Suite stakeholders from the first interaction. You communicate clearly, challenge thoughtfully, and earn credibility quickly.
You think strategically about accounts: You don't just run meetings, you map stakeholders, identify blockers, understand incentives, and continuously think about what needs to happen for the deal to move forward.
You're commercially sharp: You understand how to build a business case, quantify value, negotiate confidently, and protect deal quality while getting complex agreements across the line.
You're obsessively prepared: You know more about the prospect's business, priorities, and challenges than they expect you to. Every interaction has a purpose.
You're low ego and high accountability: You're not above doing the grunt work. You take ownership when things go wrong, act on feedback quickly, and share credit when things go right.
You speak business-level German and English
You want to work on-site 5 days a week in Berlin

💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.
For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.
What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.
Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book , which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.
We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

Most of our growth so far has happened in England. Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are three separate health systems, each with its own clinical systems, procurement routes, information governance rules and digital strategy, and none of them have an ICB layer to sell into. This role owns all three.
It is a genuinely blank page. You work out what winning looks like in each nation, then build the repeatable way to do it, selling everything from a single practice subscription to a health board wide agreement.
Owning three health systems, not one region: building pipeline across Scottish and Welsh health boards, clusters, PCNs, GP federations and HSC Trusts in Northern Ireland, and adapting your approach to the structures that actually exist in each.
Selling at every level: running fast, high volume practice level deals alongside long, multi stakeholder board and national negotiations, and knowing which one you are in.
Winning the technical argument: these deals are frequently won or lost on integration. You will hold your own with eHealth teams, IG leads and national bodies on clinical systems, APIs, deployment routes and assurance, without waiting for an engineer to join the call.
Turning pilots into contracts: generating credible local evidence and then converting it into paid, scaled agreements rather than letting it stall as a permanent trial.
Using data to pick your battles: building the territory model from list sizes, usage, adoption and pipeline data, and using it to decide where a national deal is realistic and where practice by practice is the faster path.
Building the playbook: leaving behind documented, repeatable go to market approaches per nation, so this patch scales beyond you.

You are a proven deal-closer with a track record of carrying your own number and consistently hitting it.
You are comfortable at both ends of the deal size range, equally credible on a quick practice level close and a twelve month, multi stakeholder board negotiation.
You are technically fluent and can pick up how a product integrates with the systems around it, explain it accurately to a technical audience, and stay credible when the questions get detailed.
You are not put off by complexity, whether that is clinical systems, interoperability, deployment routes or information governance. You treat it as part of the sale, not someone else’s problem.
You are a strategic thinker who can build a territory plan from a blank page, defend the choices in it, and change it when the ground shifts.
You are data-led and at home in spreadsheets, CRM and reporting tools, able to turn complex information into clear priorities and a compelling pitch.
You are a self-starter who is energised rather than unnerved by an unmapped patch and no established playbook.
You are mission-driven and motivated by the chance to change how healthcare communication works across three nations at once.

Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.
We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.
We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.
Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.
We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers — from first conversation through ongoing engagement. That means understanding what a protein design team is actually trying to achieve, helping them pick the right assays, making sure their experiments are set up correctly, and translating results back into language that's useful for their programs.

Running technical sales calls where you discuss binding kinetics, expression systems, and assay design, not just pricing

Identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts — new targets, new assay types, larger campaigns

Own the full customer lifecycle: prospecting, technical sales conversations, deal closing, onboarding, and ongoing account management.

Work closely with the biology team to ensure experiments are designed correctly and results are communicated clearly.
Build and maintain a pipeline of commercial opportunities across customer segments: AI-driven protein design companies, biotech startups, pharma R&D teams, and academic labs.
